storageAndRetention: The integration has not been implemented or activated. In the planned owner-operated workflow, the Facebook access token will be stored locally on the owner’s device and made available to the AI agent for authorized Page operations. Posts will be written manually and may be enhanced by the agent. Conversation history with the agent may be retained as the operational record; a separate logging service or log database is not planned. Local token storage does not by itself mean that prompts, post drafts, operation results or conversation history stay on the device. The actual AI service, data access and conversation-retention/deletion settings will be documented before this workflow begins. There is no currently operating integration-retention period to report.
serviceProviders: The planned workflow involves Meta for authorized Facebook Page operations and an AI agent for assisting the owner with post preparation and instructed operations. Depending on the chosen agent and how it is run, its service provider may process prompts, drafts, Page information, operation results and conversation history. The locally stored access token is a credential the agent may use; it is not post content. This integration is not active yet. Before first use, the specific AI provider and whether any credentials or Facebook information leave the device will be verified and disclosed here. We do not claim that AI assistance involves no third-party processing.
securityMeasures: The planned workflow is limited to the owner’s own Facebook Page. Access to the integration and the locally stored access token must be restricted to authorized persons and the agent acting on their instructions. The token must not be published in posts, public source code or shared diagnostic output. Conversation history can contain integration data and operational details, so its access and deletion controls must also be considered. Local storage alone is not a claim of encryption or of local-only AI processing. Additional implemented safeguards will be described only after verification.
internationalProcessing: No international transfer is currently made through this unimplemented integration. The planned AI-assisted workflow may involve remote processing of prompts, drafts, Page information and conversation history, depending on the selected service. Before first use, the actual AI provider, processing locations and applicable transfer arrangements will be verified and described here. Meta independently processes information under its own privacy policy.
